title: Euro falls as ECB's Draghi rings cautious note
主要内容: The euro fell on Thursday as European Central Bank President Mario Draghi expressed caution regarding inflation and rising protectionism, overshadowing the ECB's decision to drop a long-standing pledge to increase bond purchases. Draghi's comments came after a central bank policy meeting, with traders awaiting details on U.S. President Donald Trump's proposed tariffs on steel and aluminum, which have heightened concerns about a global trade war. Trump was expected to sign a proclamation later Thursday or on Friday to impose a 25 percent levy on steel and a 10 percent tariff on aluminum. The dollar, seen as a safe haven amid trade war fears, dipped before gaining on perceived dovish remarks from Draghi. The dollar index rose 0.58 percent to 90.15, while the euro was last down 0.85 percent at $1.2307. Traders now await news from the Bank of Japan's policy meeting and the U.S. government's payrolls report for February.
